name: imma16832_2tile
desc: IMMA.16832 multi-tile int8 GEMM (8 atoms, 32x16x64, off-diagonal output tiles): one warp computes D = C + A(32x64,s8)*B(16x64,s8)^T as 2x2 tiles of 16x8 accumulating over K. Exposes any C/D m<->n transpose that the single-atom imma16832 fixture cannot; compared bit-exact to a host integer-GEMM oracle.
